description: Current technical corpus; selection rules are authoritative, build fingerprints are generated evidence.
notes: Full PDFs, binary BDT bundles, detector snapshots and archived scientific outputs remain preserved but are not technical graph inputs.
Source files in plots and legacy geometry adapters are included. Generated images and presentations are excluded.
Unsupported text config formats are explicitly sent to fresh host semantic extraction; they are never silently omitted.
No graph outputs, query memory, plans or prior semantic caches are inputs.
Retired theory sources and operating notes are excluded. Only the retirement index and preserved bibliography describe that historical boundary.
